title: Arms Sales Notification
items_summary: Correction to notice document 2026-07235 (pages 19119-19122, April 14, 2026 issue): removes the image of a letter on page 19120 and on page 19121.
summary: This is a Defense Security Cooperation Agency correction notice for an earlier arms sales notice (document 2026-07235, published April 14, 2026, pages 19119-19122). It makes no change to any sale; it only removes the image of a letter from page 19120 and from page 19121. No purchasing country, dollar value, or equipment details are stated in this correction.
